name: kyojin
description: Kyojin (Yamz-Labs/kyojin): ExLlamaV3 server for 100 GB-class GLM-5.3 / Qwen3.8 packs on an AMD Strix Halo with 128 GB. Neither the Mac mini nor the RTX 3070 Ti can run it; use it when a Strix Halo machine joins (set KYOJIN_BASE_URL to it). Only the standard packs: LOKI does not use the uncensored presets.
